La gente de la calle que te ha dado su n: The people from the street who gave you their number. Talk to anyone with the J key.

La noche con alguien, paso a paso: A night with someone, step by step
La primera vez que pisas un barrio, adem: The first time you step into a neighborhood, the game says what it's like as well as its name. After that it only says the name. The N key repeats it whenever you want.
La radio, al bajarte del vehículo: {v}: Radio when you get out of the vehicle: {v}
La versión que tienes, quién ha hecho el: The version you have, who made the game, where to report a bug and how to buy the author a coffee.
La vida social se vive en persona: Social life is lived in person
Las bandas intentan reconquistar tus bar: Gangs try to reconquer your neighborhoods
Las misiones pagan la mitad. Cada modifi: Missions pay half. Each active modifier makes you earn experience twenty-five percent faster.
Las opciones están agrupadas por seccion: Options are grouped into sections. Press Enter to open one
Llena el depósito del vehículo que lleva: Fills the tank of the vehicle you are driving or the one you left parked next to you. You pay right away.
Llenar el depósito: ven con tu vehículo: Fill up: come with your vehicle or leave it parked next to you
Lleva cada sonido de un pack, o que haya: Brings each sound from a pack, or that you replaced by hand, to the same level as the original, so none ends up too loud or too quiet.
Lo que consta en tu ficha, cuándo caduca: What is on your record, when it expires and how to reduce it: community service or a lawyer.
Lo que llevas encima: objetos de valor e: What you are carrying: valuables you found or stole, and product. You sell them at pawn shops and store them in the wardrobe in your homes.
Los cuatro pasos para oír tu propia músi: The four steps to hear your own music on the vehicle radio, and the option that opens the folder where songs are copied.
Los delitos no cuentan y nadie te persig: Crimes don't count and nobody chases you.
Los disparos dejan de oírse desde lejos:: Gunshots can no longer be heard from far away: people don't flee and nobody calls the police over the noise. Anything you do in plain sight is still seen. You lose it along with the weapon if you get arrested.
Los enemigos de las misiones aguantan la: Mission enemies take fifty percent more damage. Each active modifier makes you earn experience twenty-five percent faster.
Los gritos y las quejas de la gente, con: People's shouts and complaints, in male or female voices, are always heard. With yes, the game also says in words who runs off or steps aside and in which direction, at most once every few seconds; if there are several, it says it all at once. With no, they are only heard.
Los que más se oyen y más ayudan a orien: The ones you hear most and that help you get your bearings, in the order it's best to learn them.
Los sonidos están por los mismos grupos: Sounds are in the same groups as in Learn the sounds. Each one is adjusted from 30 to 200 percent of its default volume, and the general volumes for effects, ambience and alerts apply on top. Press Enter to open a group
Mandos de Xbox y PlayStation: ver qué ha: Xbox and PlayStation controllers: see what each button does, reassign them and turn on vibration.

My music: how to put your songs on the radio. There are four steps: go through them with the arrow keys

Multa o soborno cuando te cogen por poco: Fine or bribe when you get caught for something minor

Música de fondo que cambia con la situac: Background music that changes with the situation. It stops by itself when you turn on the radio in a vehicle and comes back when you turn it off or get out.
Necesitas un arma de fuego en la mano. L: You need a firearm in your hand. The police will look for you, and the shop remembers you: for a few days they won't let you in.
Ningún sonido estaba cambiado: todos sig: No sound was changed: all are still at their normal volume.
Ningún sonido tiene {texto} en el nombre: No sound has {texto} in its name or description. Try another word, or fewer letters.
Ningún taxista te recoge mientras te bus: No taxi driver will pick you up while the police are looking for you.
No hay ningún lugar en esta lista: There are no places in this list

You can't save during a mission.

No, ya sé jugar: No, I know how to play
Normas de tráfico: multas y carné por pu: Traffic rules: fines and the points license
Nueva partida conservando lo ganado: New game keeping what you earned
Nueva partida conservando lo ganado. Eli: New game keeping what you earned. Choose which saved game
Pagar un soborno para que dejen de busca: Pay a bribe so they stop looking for you: {v} euros
For exploring without a care in the world.
Para guardar un vehículo, ven con él has: To store a vehicle, drive it to the door and press Enter without getting out, or leave it parked nearby and go in: the option to put it in appears in this menu. You can also send it from the phone, in My vehicles or in Services. To take one out, choose Take out of the garage. What you take out of here is still yours on the street: it doesn't disappear, and you have it on the phone, in My vehicles.
Para jugar con amigos, empieza o carga t: To play with friends, start or load your game, open the phone with the M key and go to Play with friends. From there you can open your game, with or without a password, and give them your address, or join a friend's game.
Para las misiones en las que hay que per: For missions where you have to chase a vehicle or follow someone on foot. With yes, which is the default, the game tells you more often where the target is going, with the street and direction, and calls out each turn; whoever is fleeing slows down sooner if you fall behind, you get a bit more time when there is a limit, and on foot it takes a little longer to lose sight of the person you follow. It is a light assist: you still have to do the chase. With no, everything works as usual: fewer alerts and none of those advantages. It doesn't apply on an online server.
Para llevarla encima. Si pinchas, la cam: To carry with you. If you get a flat, you change it yourself from the phone, in Services, with the vehicle stopped.
Para llevarlo encima. Si te quedas tirad: To carry with you. If you get stranded, you pour it into the tank from the phone, in Services.
Para quien oye por un solo oído o usa un: For people who hear with only one ear or use a single earphone. The sense of left and right is lost: get your bearings with the radar, the scanner and the spoken GPS.
Para vender un vehículo, ven montado en: To sell a vehicle, come riding in it
Pasar la revisión: {int} euros. Lleva {i: Get it inspected: {int} euros. It has {int2} kilometers
Patrullas de policía circulando por la c: Police patrols driving around the streets
Personas a las que puedes conocer, con l: People you can get to know, meet up with and, if things go well, become partners, get engaged, live together and get married. No adult content.
Piloto del GPS, el coche va solo hasta e: GPS autopilot, the car drives itself to the destination
Pintar y cambiar matrículas: {precio} eu: Repaint and change plates: {precio} euros. Removes the police search
Pintura nueva y matrículas nuevas. La po: New paint and new plates. The police are no longer looking for this vehicle.
Prueba de salud sexual, gratis. El trata: Sexual health test, free. Treatment, if needed, {precio} euros
Pulsa Intro para empezarlo ahora, estés: Press Enter to start it now, wherever you are. If you are far from where it takes place, the tutorial takes you there itself.
Pulsa Intro para leerla ahora. No es una: Press Enter to read it now. It is not a mission: you don't have to go anywhere or do anything. When you reach the end it counts as done.
Pulsa Intro para marcar el lugar en el G: Press Enter to mark the place on the GPS.
Press Enter to hear what to do next.
Pulsa Intro sobre cada elemento para esc: Press Enter on each item to hear its sound. A letter jumps to the next one that starts with it
Pulsa Intro sobre cada uno para escuchar: Press Enter on each one to listen to it
Pulsa Intro sobre uno para devolverlo a: Press Enter on one to set it back to its default volume
Que te curen: {v} euros. Salud actual {i: Get patched up: {v} euros. Current health {int}
Quita la sed. La comida también quita al: Quenches thirst. Food does a little too, but less.
Qué hace el juego cuando el servidor en: What the game does when the server you are playing on restarts or the connection drops.
Recorre la lista con las flechas. Escape: Go through the list with the arrow keys. Escape to go back
Recorre la localidad cruce a cruce sin m: Explore the town intersection by intersection without moving the character. Also opens with F9.
Respecto a la radio. Cámbialo con las fl: Regarding the radio. Change it with the left and right arrow keys.
Restablecer {nombre}, del grupo {titulo}: Reset {nombre}, from the group {titulo}: it is at {int} percent
Revisión pasada: aceite, frenos y ruedas: Inspection done: oil, brakes and tires. {nombre} is in proper shape.
Tire changed. It rolls well again.
Saltarte un semáforo en rojo o ir muy po: Running a red light or going well over the limit costs a fine and license points, but only if the police see you. With no points left your license is taken away, and driving in front of an officer becomes a crime. You get points back with a course at an academy. With the siren on, or when you are already wanted, there are no fines. Traffic lights count in assisted driving. The V key says how many points you have left.
Se queda aquí, con comida y agua, hasta: It stays here, with food and water, until you come back for it or call it from the phone.
Ser buena persona, delincuente o las dos: Being a good person, a criminal or both: how much standing and street reputation weigh, plus taxes, criminal record and relationships.
Servicios: hospital, comisaría y taxi: Services: hospital, police station and taxi
Servicios: vehículo, chófer, guardaespal: Services: vehicle, chauffeur, bodyguard, ambulance and taxi
Si pinchas, la cambias tú desde el móvil: If you get a flat, you change it yourself from the phone, in Services, with the vehicle stopped.
Sirve para saber a quién le puedes gusta: It lets the game know who might like you. If you'd rather not say, anyone might like you.
Solo cuenta si juegas con un personaje h: Only applies if you play with a character you created. With yes, the story lines that say your name are generated on your computer, with the characters' voices, the first time you play with that name: a few seconds of waiting at the start and the rest while you play. With no, or if your computer can't handle the generator, your screen reader says those lines.
Solo desde una casa tuya, o en su puerta: Only from one of your homes, or at its door. You choose from the menu, pay for the order and delivery, and after a while the doorbell rings. What you order takes away hunger and thirst in realistic life and gives some health. If you're not home when it arrives, the delivery person waits a while and leaves.
Sonido holgado, para equipos donde el au: Relaxed sound, for computers where the audio clicks or cuts out: {v}
Sonido mono, lo mismo por los dos oídos: Mono sound, the same in both ears
También se cambia durante el juego con F: It can also be changed during the game with F2.
Taxi: ¿a dónde te llevo? El precio depen: Taxi: where to? The price depends on the distance
You get patched up. Health at maximum.
Te llevas lo que hay en la caja, con un: You take what's in the till, with ten percent more for coming in person. The till holds seven days.
Te piden un modelo concreto: róbalo dond: They ask for a specific model: steal it where they tell you and bring it back in good condition. You can repeat it whenever you want.
Te quedas tres horas con las persianas b: You stay in for three hours with the blinds down. The police stop looking for you. It is {hora_txt}.
Termina o abandona antes la misión que t: First finish or abandon the mission you have in progress.
Time played: {h} hours and {mi} minutes. Day {dia}
Tienes un taxi en la calle. {situar}. Su: You have a taxi on the street. {situar}. Get in with F and press J to start taking fares.
Tienes {nom} y {nom2}: {total}. La banca: You have {nom} and {nom2}: {total}. The dealer shows {nom3}. Hit.
Todos los sonidos del juego, por los mis: All the game's sounds, in the same groups as in Learn the sounds, with a search box. Enter plays them and the left and right arrow keys raise or lower that specific sound, from 30 to 200 percent. It adds to the general volumes above: each sound's volume applies first, then the effects, ambience or alerts volume on top. It says how many you have changed and lets you reset one, a group or all of them.
Todos los sonidos vuelven a su volumen n: All sounds are back at their normal volume.
Todos tus vehículos, con su nombre, su m: All your vehicles, with their name, model, condition, upgrades and where each one is. From there you can mark any of them on the GPS, have it brought to you, send it to a garage or rename it. The ones you buy, upgrade at a repair shop, take out of a garage or name are yours: they don't disappear even if you walk away or take another one.
Tomar una caña con tapa: {precio} euros: Have a beer with a tapa: {precio} euros
